findings.detail: Official Eponet wiki states QR opens a browser flow whose step 1 exposes current station price and price details; operator controls start/kWh/blocking/parking fees.
Official portal documentation shows each QR is associated with Charger ID + EVSE ID; example Charger ID 25-5889 / EVSE CHEPOE0001749; downloaded filename QR-Code_CH-EPO-E0001749.svg.
Official screenshots show the QR/ad-hoc flow runs on portal.eponet.ch.
Official wiki currently links to https://www.eponet.info/adhoc_laden; current fetchers cannot reach this host/path.
Eight Charger IDs are embedded in current national inventory names, covering 23 EVSE; see switzerland-epo-charger-id-pivot-2026-09-29.json.
adhoccharging.eu currently indexes 72 Eponet stations / 338 charge points but exposes no Eponet direct prices for tested known Charger-ID sites; useful for inventory/status, not tariff resolution.
Guessed portal routes /adhoc_laden, /adhoc_laden.php, /adhoc, /publiccharge.php, /public_charging.php and /charge.php return 404; QR target likely uses a different path or tokenized/query route.
Search engines did not index portal.eponet.ch price/ad-hoc pages or exact known Charger-ID/EVSE QR targets.
Connected Firecrawl account has insufficient credits; no Firecrawl-based source inspection possible now.

nextSafeTests: Recover the QR target from an actual Eponet QR image/label for any known EVSE.
Static-inspect the Eponet Go APK/XAPK when the attachment is accessible/materialized; search strings for portal.eponet.ch, eponet.info, adhoc, QR/deep-link and API base URLs.
Inspect official wiki screenshots/assets and any downloadable quick-guide PDF for a photographed QR that can be decoded.
Use known Charger ID + EVSE pairs as validation fixtures once the target URL schema is recovered.
policy: No brute-force enumeration, no charging/payment action, no tariff extrapolation. Only public read-only endpoints and exact identity matches.
